summary: Promotion-enabling blocker pass only. Materially narrowed TER and SMR using current SEC primary filings; no queued names opened and no canonical state changed.

findings.evidence: FY2025 SEC 10-K reports $200.0m revolver outstanding at 2025-12-31 after $50.0m repayment; average interest rate 4.86%; covenant compliance as of 2026-02-19. The legacy 1.25% convertible senior notes matured 2023-12-15, so there is no live convertible principal to assemble for the current gate. 2025/2024 convertible interest expense was zero.
findings.inference: Treat current debt assembly as revolver debt, not an outstanding convertible overhang. Governance/dilution normalization remains a separate gate.
findings.gateImpact: removes debt/convertible portion of TER blocker

findings.evidence: FY2025 10-K gives $97.3m unrecognized compensation expense for non-vested RSUs/options over 2.6 years and diluted-share effects; the 2026 definitive proxy is identified as the authoritative governance/equity-plan source.
findings.inference: The remaining TER blocker is now isolated to Chief-normalized equity-plan/governance dilution treatment rather than debt uncertainty.
findings.gateImpact: materially narrows blocker but does not fully remove TER hold
findings.nextBestSourcePath: 2026 Teradyne DEF 14A equity compensation plan/share reserve tables and ownership/governance sections

findings.gate: Q2 cash burn/liquidity and financing runway
findings.evidence: At 2026-06-30 NuScale reported $766.5m cash, $305.7m short-term investments and $820.8m investments, with no debt (~$1.893b aggregate). H1 2026 operating cash use was $372.86m, including the previously disclosed ENTRA1 payment effect in Q1; H1 financing cash inflow from common-stock issuance was $984.475m. Management states liquidity plus capital-market access is sufficient for at least the next 12 months and beyond.
findings.inference: Runway is presently large but materially equity-financing-dependent; preserve dilution risk rather than treating liquidity as self-funded operating durability.
findings.gateImpact: removes Q2 liquidity/cash-burn gate; dilution remains risk input

findings.evidence: Q1 10-Q explicitly reported $962.1m of Class A shares eligible for sale under the 2026 ATM at 2026-03-31. Q2/H1 reports $984.475m financing proceeds from common-stock issuance, but this pass did not recover an explicit June-30 remaining-ATM-capacity sentence.
findings.inference: Do not subtract H1 issuance mechanically from Q1 capacity because programs/prospectus capacity may have changed; exact Q2 remaining capacity requires the Q2 equity footnote/prospectus lineage.
findings.gateImpact: narrows exact ATM gate to one explicit June-30 capacity value
findings.nextBestSourcePath: SMR 2026 Q2 10-Q common-stock/ATM footnote plus effective 2026 ATM prospectus supplement

findings.evidence: Q2 2026 revenue was only $75k and H1 revenue $640k; the filing states the prior RoPower FEED Phase 2 revenue activity was completed in late 2025 with no comparable 2026 activity. Current commercialization discussion describes prospective customers/advanced dialogue separately from executed revenue-generating agreements.
findings.inference: For methodology gating, do not count prospective deployment dialogue or nonbinding deployment narrative as current binding revenue/backlog. Recognize only executed revenue-generating agreements and reported revenue unless a binding contract is separately sourced.
findings.gateImpact: removes ambiguity by conservative evidence classification; commercial conversion timing remains non-gating unknown
